shortDescription: QXO NYSE:QXO on Thursday named Dev Ahuja as its chief financial officer, effective January 2027, succeeding Ihsan Essaid, who will become vice chairman of the construction supplies distributor.

children: on Thursday named Dev Ahuja as its chief financial officer, effective January 2027, succeeding Ihsan Essaid, who will become vice chairman of the construction supplies distributor.
Ahuja joins from aluminum solutions provider Novelis, where he had been the finance chief since 2016
At Novelis, Ahuja led the $2.8 billion Aleris acquisition and helped raise $8 billion in financing, QXO said
Essaid, who has been the CFO since July 2024, will oversee mergers and acquisitions and advance capital-raising activities as vice chairman, the company said
CEO Brad Jacobs called M&A a core driver of value creation as QXO pursues its goal of $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade
Shares of the company were down 1% before the bell

title: QXO names Novelis' Dev Ahuja as CFO; Essaid to become vice chairman
